summary: Browser-level verification of the /auth kick-back bug fix and remember-me feature. All 4 requested critical flows PASSED: (1) OTP step stays put for 8+ seconds with no navigation away, (2) remember=checked saves misbah_token to localStorage and root '/' redirects to /dashboard on reload, (3) remember=unchecked login succeeds without saving token to localStorage, (4) duplicate name registration is rejected with Arabic error 'هذا الاسم مسجل مسبقاً – اختاري اسماً آخر' and user stays on /auth. Regression: remember checkbox visible on OTP step, default checked. Dashboard renders (data-testid=dashboard-root) with no console crash. Cleanup: deleted 2 test users (t1/t2) from MongoDB; t3 was never persisted (duplicate-name path blocked before insert).
critical_code_review_comments: AuthPage useEffect redirect correctly guarded by step==='email' — bug fix verified end-to-end in browser.
axios interceptor + localStorage fallback works transparently; cookie-only session still supported when remember=false.
Backend rejects duplicate name before consuming OTP (good — OTP not wasted on validation failure).
test_credentials: Passwordless OTP; test emails t1/t2/t3.test@misbah.dev — cleaned from DB post-test.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — 2 test users created and deleted after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kick-back bug fix + remember-me confirmed working. Two 401 console errors observed briefly right after logout — these are the /auth/me probe firing before AuthContext clears; harmless. OTP input pattern that works: click [data-testid=auth-otp-input] then page.keyboard.type(code). Remember checkbox data-state attribute reflects Radix Checkbox state ('checked' / null when unchecked).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: AuthPage had a useEffect that watched auth state and redirected on login — but it fired unconditionally, so during the OTP step (after request-otp cleared/refreshed something) it navigated user away. Fix: guard the redirect with step==='email' so it only runs on the initial email screen, never during OTP entry. Verified: 8s idle wait on OTP step retains OTP input visible.
